Tesla faces lawsuit and investigations over fatal Texas crash

A Tesla vehicle, allegedly with driver-assistance technology engaged, crashed into a Texas home, resulting in the death of a 76-year-old woman. The incident has prompted a lawsuit from the victim's family against Tesla, seeking damages and punitive measures. The US government has also opened a second federal investigation into the crash, focusing on the vehicle's autopilot and full self-driving features.
